anomalies: 8 of the 85 pages are empty shells with only YAML front matter plus an H1 title and no **Signature** line at all (CellTextHorizontalJustification, CellTextVerticalJustification, ColumnHidden, DisplayedText, DisplayedText2, RowHidden, Text, Text2) — because they carry no signature they can be counted neither as zero-arg methods nor as properties, so E and F rest on signature evidence only and these 8 stay unjudgeable.

This family has zero pointer-family members: the literal string 'in-process, unmanaged C++' does not occur anywhere in any of the 85 files, so both pointer_returns and pointer_params_only are 0 rather than merely unmeasured.

All 10 obsolete headers use the identical wording 'Obsolete. Superseded by [[...]]', all at line 12 as a line-start token, so obsolete_loose equals obsolete_strict and this family contains no 'Obsolete for documents created in ...' or 'Obsolete and not superseded' style variants.

InsertColumn.md's obsolete line contains a typo in the official source itself: it points at [[ITableAnnnotation::InsertColumn2]] (three n's in 'Annnotation'), so that cross-reference does not resolve to the real member.
InsertRow.md declares `System.bool InsertRow(...)` but has no ## Returns section at all (Parameters is followed directly by Remarks), the only non-void member in the family missing its Returns block.

HorizontalAutoSplit declares return type System.object while its Returns text says 'Array of split [[ITableAnnotation]]s' — the declared type does not express the array, and the phrase 'Array of' here carries no machine-readable type.

GetColumnWidth, GetRowHeight, GetRowVerticalGap, SetColumnWidth, SetRowHeight and SetRowVerticalGap all describe their Returns only as 'in system units' / 'Gap in system units' without naming the unit, so no numeric unit can be read off these pages.

Six members declare non-namespaced return/property types (Annotation, TextFormat, TableAnnotation, GeneralTableFeature) while the rest of the family uses System.*, so a signature-driven scanner must not assume the System. prefix is universal.
GetColumnType.md's See Also block ends with [[ITableAnnotation::GetLockColumnWidth Method]] listed twice — a duplicate link present in the official source.

GetUseDocTextFormat.md writes four See Also links as [[ITableAnnotation:GetXxx Method]] with a single colon instead of the '::' used everywhere else, so those links are malformed by the source's own convention.
